IITIIT Gandhinagar · Research internship Closed

IIT Gandhinagar Visiting Students Research Engagement Programme (Sem II 2026–27)

Spend a semester at IIT Gandhinagar on faculty-supervised research, earning up to 16 credits of research engagement in 4-credit modules.

STIPEND / MONTH
₹5,000
Stipend details
₹5,000 for each quad in which the student earns B or above (up to about ₹20,000 per semester). No tuition fee; hostel and mess paid by the student.
Application deadline
27 Oct 2026, 17:00 IST
Format & location
In person · Gandhinagar, Gujarat
Who can apply
Final-year BTech/BS (4-year) or integrated MSc/BS-MS (5-year) students at IITs, IISc, NITs and IISERs with CPI/CGPA above 8.0.
Accommodation & support
No tuition fee · hostel and mess paid by the student

Entry notes

  • Separate from IITGN's SRIP summer programme.
  • The amount is per quad and depends on grades, not a fixed monthly stipend.
  • Research
  • Semester internship
  • STEM
  • IIT
